section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section asks for the source of the statement that almost all souls in our generations are called by the name "seed of an animal."
section.t: In the maamar there, section 7 at its beginning,
that almost all the souls in our generations are called by the name "seed of an animal."
So what is the source for this?

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section cites the source in Torah Ohr of the Alter Rebbe and its basis in the Zohar, with additional references.
section.t: So it is in Torah Ohr of the Alter Rebbe
(author of the Tanya and Shulchan Aruch)
at the beginning of Parshat Mishpatim.
And it is based on what is written in the Zohar, Part II, at the beginning of Parshat Mishpatim
And also see Likkutei Torah of our Rebbe (the Alter Rebbe) on Parshat Tzav
